card.title: 76th NAPOLI
card.text: Deployment: Gets +1 attack for each defense your HQ has over the enemy HQ.
card.flavorText: The 76th Infantry Regiment “Napoli” of the 54th Infantry Division "Napoli" was a military unit of the Royal Italian Army during WWII. The division was formed in Sicily in 1939 and later deployed to focus on coastal defense in the southern part of the island in preparation for the anticipated Allied invasion. On 10 July 1943, the Napoli division engaged in fighting south of Noto, while its northern group fought at Lentini and Brucoli. The British captured Floridia and the entirety of the 75th Infantry Regiment on 12 July as it attempted to withdraw from the town. The division managed to stabilize the frontline at Palazzolo Acreide-Solarino-Priolo Gargallo by 13 July, but the new Allied landing north of Augusta outflanked the division and inflicted heavy casualties in the following days. The remnants of the Napoli division were absorbed into the incoming Panzer Division "Hermann Göring" and fought some small rearguard battles between 16-24 July. The division was disbanded on 14 August 1943 after it was unable to reform and its remaining personnel were ordered to evacuate to Southern Italy. For its conduct between 10 July and 1 August 1943 the 76th Infantry Regiment was awarded a Silver Medal of Military Valour.
